text: The purpose of this report is to provide an opportunity for Transportation Services to present the City's strategic timing for sidewalk clearing to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee, as part of the City's Major Snow Event Response Plan. Myles Currie, Acting Director, Winter and Seasonal Services, Transportation Services will give a presentation on City of Toronto Winter Maintenance Strategic Timing for Sidewalk Clearing.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee: 1. Received the report (November 27, 2025) from the Acting General Manager, Transportation Services for information.
